column1: # The paired tamper corpus, machine-readable. One row per case.
# EVERY row records BOTH halves. control=ACCEPTED is what makes the corpus
# non-trivial: a table of refusals alone is passed by a verifier that refuses
# everything. A row with control=REFUSED is a corpus defect, not a pass, and the
# plan's PAIRED-RESULT gate fails on any such row.
# Source of every result: tamper-corpus-run.txt, the live
# run on hetzner-dsm at commit f6196a3275d41eaf769d4271b38d145e18739f26. Each
# case has its own TAMPER-CASE line in that transcript.
# The corpus's own ability to go red is proved separately in
# tamper-negative-controls.txt: four deliberate defects (a no-op mutation, all
# controls refused, a dropped object class, an inert mutation) each turned the
# suite red, and the tree restored byte-clean afterwards.
